entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Sorry for coming over out of the blue.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: You must have a real knack for coffee,[n][lName]-kun. This is fantastic.
You wanted to talk?
Another cup?[clr 27]
We've got curry too.[clr 27]

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Well, actually...

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Thanks, but I think I'll pass for today.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: I'd love to try some... but I think I'd[n]better restrain myself for now.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: It's about the research we've been[n]discussing. I'm actually putting it all[n]together in a paper.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: It's been really progressing lately, thanks[n]in no small part to you. But I feel like I've[n]hit another wall...

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: So I'm sorry to bother you, but I'd[n]appreciate if you'd help me talk[n]through this again.
I can do that.[clr 27]
It's a deal.
I'm not up for this...

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Really!? Thank you! You're really saving[n]me here!

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Thank you! I really do rely on you,[n][lName]-kun.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: I-I know, but please! I'm begging you![n]There's no one else I can rely on!

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: In deepening our understanding of the[n]heart, I wanted to find a means of helping[n]those who have been hurt by traumas...

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: I already told you that was the point[n]of all my research, right?

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: It's thanks to you that my project has[n]come this far.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: But because of all that progress... I've[n]realized a problem. One that may not[n]have any solution.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Even if my research makes great strides,[n]even if we DO find some miraculous way[n]of healing psychological wounds...

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: With the way things are now, I can only[n]save the people directly within my reach.
Isn't that enough?
You need more than that?

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: ...True, I guess. It's better than not being[n]able to save anyone. But I can't just be[n]satisfied with that.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: I mean, there are so many people out[n]there suffering so badly, they can't[n]even speak up and let that pain out.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: ...This is a painful, cruel, bitter world.[n]And there's only so much one individual[n]can do to fight against that.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: I've said it before. Working as a counselor[n]only makes that more painfully obvious.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: I think our current way of doing things...[n]just isn't enough.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Deep down, I... I don't think it's enough[n]that I can just help people around me.[n]A few people, out of billions.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: I want to help more people overcome[n]their suffering.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Pain can strike the heart in infinitely[n]diverse ways. In turn, we have infinite[n]methods by which we try to treat it.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: And like I said earlier... there are people[n]who need help, desperately, but can't ask[n]for it. They can't even share their pain.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Even if we had a full understanding of[n]the human heart, and an effective[n]treatment to soothe it...

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: I don't think that would be enough to[n]finally beat trauma. And I guess that's[n]what I ultimately realized.
So what CAN we do?
It's a hard question...
So give up.[clr 27]

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: I haven't been able to get the question[n]out of my head, but... I don't have any[n]answers. I'm not used to that.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: I know, right...? Maybe this one's a little[n]too much for you to handle.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Yeah, that'd probably be easier...[n]Unfortunately, I've never been great[n]at giving up when I should.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: If we could peer into the hearts of every[n]person alive... Diagnose, understand, and[n]then remove the root cause of their pain...

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: ...It sounds like something out of a dream.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Ah, let me put it this way. Counseling[n]takes time because you have to really[n]listen to each individual person, right?

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: I just think it'd be better if there was some[n]way to really understand everyone's[n]cognitions more quickly and accurately.
Everyone's cognition...?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: More importantly, what is this Mementos!?[n]It's about time you start explaining.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Mementos is... everyone's Palace.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Think of it as the collective unconscious...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: No, never mind. You wouldn't[n]understand that.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Then again, that'd be impossible. Maybe[n]truly understanding all people's hearts[n]is beyond human capability.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Hm? [lName]-kun... Did I[n]say something wrong?
All hearts share some things.
What if they're connected?

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Huh? Yes, there are common factors...

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Haha, where's this coming from? Sure,[n]they can connect, but...

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: No, wait...

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: You're right...! My god, you're right![n]That's it, [lName]-kun!

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: The collective unconscious... If people's[n]hearts are connected in the unconscious,[n]their senses are shared subconsciously...!

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Ah, it's so simple! Why didn't I realize[n]it before...?

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Yes, right, and... If I can combine this with[n]the theory I'm verifying, I can tie it all[n]back to cognitive psience, too...!
Calm down.
Where's this coming from?
Cognitive psience?

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: S-Sorry! But I think you've just helped[n]me make a major breakthrough!

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: I think this means something big for my[n]cognitive psience research! I need to[n]hurry and get this down in my paper!

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Huh? Yes, what about it...?

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Oh, I didn't say earlier? The research[n]I'm doing is on cognitive psience...

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Ah, but I'm sorry, I need to go! I need[n]to get this in my paper while it's still[n]fresh in my mind!

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: I knew it'd be worth bringing to you!

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Thank you, [lName]-kun! I swear[n]I'll repay you for this!
I can sense a powerful[n]gratitude from Maruki...

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Well, I need to get going! See you!
